name: Qube Browser 0.1.14-alpha
notes:
Rendering
- A blank window now says so. The engine published a shared surface even when
  nothing had been bound to it, so the shell mounted one that could never
  receive a pixel -- and the "nothing is being drawn" notice was suppressed
  along with it. Both fixed.

Security
- A Web Store install is bound to the prompt you saw: approving records the
  extension id and manifest, and the install refuses anything that does not
  match.
- Installers may only come from the release origin.
- Two internal pipes are restricted to your own account.
- Releases record the engine and shell commit they were built from.

Other
- Engine logging can be switched off with QBROWSER_NO_ENGINE_LOG=1. It is on by
  default, writes continuously, and contains the urls you visit.
- Lost input is recorded instead of vanishing.

Known
- An extension popup takes about a second to appear.
- There is no fallback if shared-surface rendering fails.
summary: A security and rendering release. The one worth testing on an unusual adapter: a blank window now explains itself instead of staying silent.
